div.div: - Skipping bootstrap: deploy fails with an SSM parameter not found.
- Changing something in the console and watching the next deploy undo it (drift).
- Missing tags or permissions, so the stack lands in ROLLBACK.
- Mismatched versions between the Python library and the CDK CLI.

div.div: - cdk ls lists the stacks in the app.
- cdk doctor checks the local environment and versions.
- cdk deploy --all --require-approval never deploys every stack without prompting.
- cdk destroy --force tears a stack down without asking for confirmation.
